items.source: producing structural relationships behind a common `ParseResult` interface
evidence: probe: 'import fs = require("fs");' in a .ts file -> no ParsedImport
probe: 'const C = class { m() {} };' -> no ParsedClass; method emitted as top-level function qualified_name 'm'
probe: 'const D = class extends B {};' -> no ParsedClass, no inherits
no 'export' keyword, generator, re-export, class expression, or TS import-equals appears in any committed fixture, so the passing snapshot suite cannot detect GAP-5/6/7

documented deliberate exclusions: Go has no classes/inheritance; TS interface/implements excluded; raw unresolved callee/base/module strings; anonymous callbacks and IIFEs excluded; no Module/DEPENDS_ON extraction
